build_video2video_controlnet_pipeline: build a python module to run AnimateDiffVideoToVideoControlNetPipeline for video-to-video generation with ControlNet guidance
run_pipeline_call: run the AnimateDiffVideoToVideoControlNetPipeline call function to generate a video from an input video with prompt and conditioning frames
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text encoder hidden states using the encode_prompt method
prepare_latents_for_generation: prepare initial latents from an input video by encoding through VAE and adding noise using prepare_latents
prepare_conditioning_frames: prepare ControlNet conditioning frames by preprocessing and reshaping video frames using prepare_conditioning_frames
